# Hydrogen Therapy Shows Promise for Psoriasis Relief

New research suggests that hydrogen therapy could help people with [psoriasis](/explore-by-condition/psoriasis) find relief from painful, scaly skin patches. This breakthrough study shows how hydrogen might calm inflammation and help skin heal naturally.

## What the Research Shows

Scientists created a special gel that releases hydrogen gas directly onto the skin. This gel helped reduce the thick, scaly patches that are common in psoriasis. The [original research study](/study/reshaping-psoriasis-topical-therapy-continuous-hydrogenation-orchestrates-redox-metabolic-homeostasis-for-efficient-remission-and-relapse-intervention-1777577833831) found that hydrogen therapy worked by fixing problems with how skin cells grow and use energy.

The hydrogen treatment helped restore balance in the skin. It slowed down the rapid growth of skin cells that causes psoriasis patches. This is important because in psoriasis, skin cells grow about 10 times faster than normal.

## How Hydrogen Water Delivery Works

While this study used a special hydrogen gel applied to the skin, molecular hydrogen (H2) can also be delivered through drinking hydrogen-rich water. Hydrogen water machines and water ionizers like those from Echo Water™ create water with dissolved hydrogen gas. When you drink this water, the hydrogen travels through your body and may help reduce inflammation.

The study used a sustained-release method that kept hydrogen working for hours. This shows that getting hydrogen into your body regularly might be important for seeing benefits.

## How to Apply This for Skin Health

Based on what we know about hydrogen therapy and [chronic inflammatory skin disorders](/explore-by-condition/chronic-inflammatory-skin-disorders), here are some practical steps:

### Daily Hydrogen Water Routine
- Drink 1-2 glasses of hydrogen water in the morning
- Have another glass before meals
- Aim for about 16-24 ounces of hydrogen water per day

### Timing Matters
- Drink hydrogen water on an empty stomach when possible
- The hydrogen gas stays in water for only a few hours, so drink it fresh
- Consider drinking hydrogen water twice daily for consistent levels

### Supporting Your Skin
- Stay hydrated with regular water too
- Eat foods rich in antioxidants (berries, leafy greens)
- Protect your skin from harsh chemicals and excessive sun

## What to Look For in Hydrogen Water

Not all hydrogen water is the same. Here's what makes a quality hydrogen water machine:

### Hydrogen Concentration
- Look for dissolved H2 levels above 1.0 ppm (parts per million)
- Higher concentrations may provide better benefits
- Check that the machine can maintain these levels

### ORP Levels
- ORP stands for Oxidation Reduction Potential
- Good hydrogen water should have negative ORP values
- This shows the water has antioxidant properties

### Third-Party Testing
- Choose machines tested by independent labs
- Look for certifications and quality standards
- Avoid machines that make unrealistic health claims

The growing field of [hydrogen skin research](/blog/category/skin) continues to explore how hydrogen therapy might help various skin conditions. While this study focused on a topical gel, drinking hydrogen water may provide similar anti-inflammatory benefits throughout the body.

## Key Takeaways

• **Hydrogen therapy shows promise**: The study found that hydrogen helped reduce inflammation and slow down rapid skin cell growth in psoriasis models

• **Consistency matters**: Regular hydrogen exposure appeared more effective than occasional use, suggesting daily hydrogen water consumption could be beneficial

• **Multiple benefits**: Hydrogen therapy worked by fixing energy problems in cells and reducing harmful oxidative stress

• **Quality is important**: Choose hydrogen water machines that produce high concentrations of dissolved hydrogen and have third-party testing

While this research is exciting, it was done in laboratory models, not human patients. More studies are needed to confirm these benefits in people with psoriasis. However, the results suggest that hydrogen therapy could become a valuable tool for managing skin inflammation.

The [hydrogen research database](/proxy/) contains many studies exploring how hydrogen therapy might help various health conditions. As scientists continue to study hydrogen's effects on inflammation and cell health, we may discover even more ways this simple molecule can support our wellbeing.

*Consult your healthcare provider before starting any new health regimen, especially if you have psoriasis or other skin conditions.*
